_how_to_edit: Edit this file to update the site; every list renders in the order written. Placards: research_cards, outlet_cards, speaking_cards and service_cards each hold cards with kind, name, meta, status, optional url and wide, and items (title, url, note). Then run python3 scripts/build_static.py so index.html's static copy, which search engines read, matches. Each card shows its logo from the `logo` path (assets/logos/*.png) when that file exists, and otherwise a badge with the short `mark` text.
